title: Understanding the Intercept
text: The intercept, $$\theta_0$$, in a regression model represents the predicted value of the dependent variable when all independent variables are zero.

title: Zero Values for Independent Variables
text: Consider what it means for a student to have $$0$$ hours of sleep and not be affiliated with a CDSS major.

hintAnswer: $$\theta_0$$ is the predicted GPA for a student who gets $$0$$ hours of sleep and does not have a CDSS affiliated major.
